22:     /// @dev A bitmap in storage.

25:     }

31:     /// @dev Returns the boolean value of the bit at `index` in `bitmap`.
32:     function get(Bitmap storage bitmap, uint256 index) internal view returns (bool isSet) {
33:         // It is better to set `isSet` to either 0 or 1, than zero vs non-zero.
34:         // Both cost the same amount of gas, but the former allows the returned value
35:         // to be reused without cleaning the upper bits.
36:         uint256 b = (bitmap.map[index >> 8] >> (index & 0xff)) & 1;
37:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
38:         assembly {
39:             isSet := b
40:         }
41:     }
42: 
43:     /// @dev Updates the bit at `index` in `bitmap` to true.
44:     function set(Bitmap storage bitmap, uint256 index) internal {
45:         bitmap.map[index >> 8] |= (1 << (index & 0xff));
46:     }
47: 
48:     /// @dev Updates the bit at `index` in `bitmap` to false.
49:     function unset(Bitmap storage bitmap, uint256 index) internal {
50:         bitmap.map[index >> 8] &= ~(1 << (index & 0xff));
51:     }
52: 
53:     /// @dev Flips the bit at `index` in `bitmap`.
54:     /// Returns the boolean result of the flipped bit.
55:     function toggle(Bitmap storage bitmap, uint256 index) internal returns (bool newIsSet) {
56:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
57:         assembly {
58:             mstore(0x20, bitmap.slot)
59:             mstore(0x00, shr(8, index))
60:             let storageSlot := keccak256(0x00, 0x40)
61:             let shift := and(index, 0xff)
62:             let storageValue := xor(sload(storageSlot), shl(shift, 1))
63:             // It makes sense to return the `newIsSet`,
64:             // as it allow us to skip an additional warm `sload`,
65:             // and it costs minimal gas (about 15),
66:             // which may be optimized away if the returned value is unused.
67:             newIsSet := and(1, shr(shift, storageValue))
68:             sstore(storageSlot, storageValue)
69:         }
70:     }

72:     /// @dev Updates the bit at `index` in `bitmap` to `shouldSet`.
73:     function setTo(Bitmap storage bitmap, uint256 index, bool shouldSet) internal {
74:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
75:         assembly {
76:             mstore(0x20, bitmap.slot)
